newsitem.title: ITALY: Specialists get 37 bln lire worth of Italy CTZs.
newsitem.headline: Specialists get 37 bln lire worth of Italy CTZs.

text.p: Specialist bond traders bid for and were allocated 17 billion lire worth of 18-month CTZ against the Italian Treasury's offer of 150 billion lire, and 20 billion lire worth of two-year CTZ against 200 billion lire on offer.
Earlier, the Treasury received bids for 3.33 trillion lire at the open auction for the December 30, 1998 zero coupon certificates against 1.5 trillion lire worth on offer.
The gross yield was set at 5.95 percent.
Bids for the July 15, 1999 CTZ totalled 4.34 trillion lire against the Treasury's offer of 2.0 trillion lire.
The gross yield was set at 5.88 percent.
